content: Hexagonal (ports & adapters) for LLM provider abstraction: core domain stays pure with no direct external deps; ports = interfaces defined by domain; adapters = implementations connecting to LLM APIs and serve as anti-corruption layer protecting core from a foreign vendor model. Dependency rule: source deps point inward only; inner (domain) knows nothing about outer (infra). Applied to AI agents: define a driven port (e.g. DraftingProvider) the domain calls, with one adapter per SDK. Pitfall: over-abstraction / premature ports add technical debt - keep the seam thin and shaped by what the domain actually needs, not by mirroring the vendor API.
